name: Do As ~Muraosa no Iinari~
original_name: ドゥアズ ～ムラオサノ言いなり～
source:
After losing her parents in a sudden accident and being left with no relatives, Suzune is taken in by the chief of the village where she lived as a child. When she arrives, she finds her childhood friend (the protagonist) there, bringing back nostalgic memories. By the protagonist's side is his grandfather, the hereditary village chief, who eyes her lecherously. The village chief assigns his grandson a certain role.

The village has a certain custom that has continued for over 300 years in order to ensure the perpetuation of descendants...

[Translated from the [url=https://www.girls-software.com/doas/#character]official website[/url]]
translation:
铃音在一场突如其来的事故中失去了父母，没有了亲人，被小时候居住的村长收留了。当她到达时，她发现儿时的朋友（主角）在那里，勾起了她的怀旧回忆。主角身边是他的祖父，世袭的村长，他用好色的眼神看着她。村长给他的孙子分配了一定的角色。

村里有一个延续了300多年的习俗，以确保子孙永续……

[翻译自[url=https://www.girls-software.com/doas/#character]官网[/url]]
